meta.name: product-capability
meta.description: Translate PRD intent, roadmap asks, or product discussions into an implementation-ready capability plan that exposes constraints, invariants, interfaces, and unresolved decisions before multi-service work starts. Use when the user needs an ECC-native PRD-to-SRS lane instead of vague planning prose.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将产品讨论转化为可执行的实现计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需把模糊的产品意图转化为开发团队能直接执行的技术方案。
copy.tagline_en: Turn product discussions into actionable implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to translate vague product intent into concrete technical specs for development teams.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能将产品需求转化为工程约束清单，包括能力描述、约束条件、接口定义和未决问题，并给出下一步执行建议。
howto.when: 当你有产品需求文档、路线图讨论或创始人笔记，但实现细节还不明确时触发。

say.text: 把这份 PRD 转成能力计划，列出所有约束和未决问题。
say.note: Claude 会输出能力描述、约束、接口和下一步建议。

say.text: 这个功能涉及多个服务，帮我写一份能力契约。
say.note: Claude 会生成跨服务的能力计划，包括非目标和开放问题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude transforms product intent into an engineering constraint list, including capability description, constraints, interfaces, and open questions, with next-step recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have a PRD, roadmap discussion, or founder note but implementation details are still unclear.

say_en.text: Convert this PRD into a capability plan, listing all constraints and open questions.
say_en.note: Claude outputs capability description, constraints, interfaces, and next steps.

say_en.text: This feature spans multiple services; write a capability contract for it.
